examples.note: The baseline captures the problem, DeepSeek/HTML method, prompt parameters, rendered-result copy target, and visible success result.
It repeatedly identifies the demonstrated target as Word, although the independently audited screen shows WPS Writer and only the narration uses Word generically.
It mentions local font availability but does not report the central visible limits: no Microsoft Word test, no save/reopen test, and no property-panel verification of exact formatting values.
The baseline supplies no timestamp, cue, shot, or frame locator for any atomic knowledge unit. Correct prose without an independently checkable locator is not counted as a unit with valid evidence.
